displayIdentity.body: A race and disciplined body close the defense. Don’t you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, so that you may win. but I beat my body and bring it into submission, lest by any means, after I have preached to others, I myself should be disqualified.
displayIdentity.title: A race and disciplined body close the defense
